name: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Operates the central observability platform and owns reliability across the Technology & Engineering value stream, spanning alert intake, runbook automation, and hypercare on go-lives. Runs chaos engineering experiments, blameless root-cause analyses, and post-incident reviews, documenting remediation controls for auditability and governing AIOps models used in incident pattern learning.

name: Software Engineer
description: Builds and certifies solutions within the Technology & Engineering value stream, validating implementations against architecture standards and testing integrations end to end. Contributes to real-time data engineering, quality assurance, and backlog prioritization, scoring change risk and recording compensating controls under implementation governance while curating engineering knowledge and improving developer experience.

name: Solutions Architect
description: Owns solution architecture across the Technology & Engineering value stream, maintaining the enterprise architecture repository and convening the Architecture Review Board. Governs change policy and emergency changes, scoring change risk and recording compensating controls, while shaping the technology roadmap, modernization planning, and technology vendor evaluations against reference-architecture standards.

name: Statutory Reporting Manager
description: Leads statutory financial reporting within Finance & Investments, preparing financial statements and statutory reserve schedules and managing regulatory financial examinations. Oversees reserve setting and actuarial data quality, reconciling claims data and ALAE actuals against accruals, and supports capital instruments management, share repurchase programs, and merger and acquisition financial reporting.

name: Strategic Planning Analyst
description: Supports Corporate Strategy & Development within the Executive Office by analyzing market, competitive, and performance data to inform enterprise strategic plans. Prepares planning materials, scenario models, and progress reporting that help leadership set direction and track execution of corporate initiatives.

name: Submission Intake Specialist
description: Coordinates submission intake and policy binding within the Underwriting value stream, revising and re-issuing quotes to brokers with negotiated terms. Administers reinsurance program tasks including treaty retention screening and bordereaux preparation, processes mid-term endorsements, and supports appetite guideline compliance, exception tracking, and underwriting quality assurance.

name: Subrogation / Litigation Specialist
description: Performs recovery and litigation work within the Claims value stream, posting recovery receipts to the claims ledger and closing demand files. Evaluates and documents liability decisions, manages denials with follow-ups for appeals, monitors claims workflow routing exceptions, and tracks retained-asset-account compliance reported to regulators on schedule.

name: Sustainability Risk Manager
description: Oversees sustainability-related risk within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, maintaining the risk appetite framework, risk taxonomy, and policy governance. Supports market conduct examinations with document production and corrective-action plans, tiers vendors at TPRM intake, contributes to model risk management, and triages and closes compliance issues in the register.

name: Systems Administrator
description: Administers AIOps-driven operations within the Data & AI value stream, maintaining runbook automation, auto-remediation, and event correlation. Governs AIOps models, reviews automation effectiveness quarterly and retires obsolete runbooks, forecasts resource saturation for predictive capacity management, and maps service-to-infrastructure dependencies to reduce incident recurrence.

name: Systems Analyst
description: Performs systems configuration and platform engineering across the Technology & Engineering, Data & AI, and Cybersecurity & IAM value streams. Provisions cloud infrastructure under landing-zone governance, hardens security baselines and publishes control standards, onboards applications to SSO and manages identity federation trusts, and supports data source ingestion and environment lifecycle management.

name: Tax Analyst
description: Performs tax compliance work within the Finance & Investments value stream, filing income, premium, and payroll tax returns by statutory deadlines. Administers 1099-R reporting from data compilation through corrected returns, supports the tax provision and uncertain tax position reserves, models tax impacts of proposed transactions, and compiles documentation for tax controversy responses.

name: Tax Director
description: Leads the tax function within Finance & Investments, owning income tax compliance, tax provision, and tax planning across the enterprise. Directs premium tax filings including retaliatory tax adjustments, oversees 1099-R administration through IRS transmission and record retention, manages tax controversy matters, and ensures tax payments reconcile to general ledger accruals.

name: Tax Manager
description: Manages tax compliance operations within Finance & Investments, ensuring returns are filed by statutory deadlines and extensions are properly approved. Coordinates 1099-R administration from recipient statements to IRS transmission and retention, applies state premium tax rates and retaliatory adjustments, and reconciles tax payments to general ledger accruals under the tax provision and planning agenda.
